_doc: Files imported from torrent downloads on the Synology. The bytes are already on site_a/site_b at the indicated file_path (synology-to-synology copy). sanitize_and_assemble.py reads this manifest and emits AssetRecord entries with source_root='torrent_import'. populate_archive.py treats those as already-in-place and verifies size rather than re-copying.
